messages:
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout for inference-gateway v3.2.1 -> 20% traffic to canary pool
maya: seeing failing healthchecks on canary nodes, 4/6 failing
sam: quick look at logs — env decrypt error when booting services
maya: paging oncall
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-099 -> Priority: P1. Paging @oncall
jordan: attaching truncated logs from canary-3
maya: ```
ERROR com.redwood.env.DecryptException: decrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/ef12-rotated-2026
Caused by: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ci-deploy-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/ef12-rotated-2026
at com.redwood.env.KmsClient.decrypt(KmsClient.java:112)
at com.redwood.runtime.Main.init(Main.java:58)
```
alex: that rotated key alias was created by the rotation-run earlier today. It looks like the new key policy doesn't include ci-deploy-role
sam: can someone flip our canary kill-switch? need to stop traffic to the canary pool ASAP
jordan: console toggle attempt failed — script expects flag CANARY_PAUSE but console flag is canary.pause (case/syntax mismatch)
maya: of course. our emergency toggle script normalizes keys to upper+underscores, but console was created with dot notation
infra-ops-bot: creating emergency routing change -> reducing canary weight to 0%
deploy-bot: Routing change applied: canary-weight=0%
sam: initiating canary rollback to stable v3.2.0 on the canary nodes only
alex: I've opened IAM ticket IAM-2026-812 to add kms:Decrypt for ci-deploy-role on the new key; assigning to infra team
infra-ops-bot: IAM-2026-812 assigned to @alex
alex: adding decrypt permission now and reapplying key policy; will post when done
maya: rollback in progress, monitoring healthchecks
support-liaison: monitoring customer impact — small spike in 502s to canary endpoints, about 10% of canary-routed requests failing; estimated 6 tenants impacted, outreach in progress
alex: key policy updated, decrypt permission granted to ci-deploy-role; redeploying canaries to validate
sam: canary nodes finished rollback and report healthy (6/6)
maya: canary pool healthy, traffic kept at 0% until we verify deploy and flag consistency
support-liaison: customer advisory sent to affected tenants, no SLA breach detected so far
jordan: handoff: @maya handing to @sam for 1 hour of follow-up and metric watch
sam: taking handoff — will observe error-rate and key audit logs for 2 hours
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE INC-2026-099 -> Status: mitigated. Preliminary root cause: KMS key rotation produced a key policy missing the deploy role -> decrypt failures; secondary failure: feature-flag key naming mismatch prevented immediate kill-switch toggle
maya: postmortem action items: 1) rotation job must validate key policies and perform smoke decrypts using deploy role 2) normalize feature-flag naming conventions across deploy scripts and console 3) implement automated fallback: if canary health drops and manual toggle fails, auto-reroute off canaries after X failures
alex: will open PR to rotation runner to include follow-up permission verification and a unit test: PR#1502
sam: adding alert to detect feature-flag key vs deploy-env key mismatches
support-liaison: scheduled a customer follow-up summary for tomorrow 09:00 PT
jordan: closing the incident channel and moving notes to #postmortems/INC-2026-099 for write-up
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED INC-2026-099 at 2026-03-17T22:07:30Z
